reuse.why: Takes its categories from the existing getBudgetableCategories and writes via setBudget/getSheetValue/batchMessages, exactly like the other month-wide actions.

duplication.why: Only the small income/expense sign flip is written inline again, mirroring the existing per-action pattern rather than a shared helper (none exists).

placement.why: The action sits in budget/actions.ts and is registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) like its siblings.

scope.why: Adds just the action, its registration, one test and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short, conventional action that inherits category selection changes automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: uses getBudgetableCategories rather than its own category query

disguised_duplication.where: none; the sign flip is the tree's usual inline idiom, not a reshaped copy
